cards.title: FrameContact: three outputs on the corrected historical test
cards.answer: Corrected test 549 routed medians: contact AP 0.02667, epitope AP 0.22031, paratope AP 0.69859. The old 455 cache was not held out for this checkpoint.
cards.inputs: Sequence plus independently predicted intra-chain geometry; no bound complex pose
cards.estimand: Mean-per-complex AP, not pooled AP or accuracy
cards.boundary: This correction applies to the specific checkpoint, not every official 455 evaluation. Some AF3 predictions use homolog MSAs. Not fresh blind or proven sequence-double-cold evidence.

cards.title: Aligned features versus shuffled and width controls
cards.answer: Aligned ESM-IF1 minus ESM-2: +0.005111 AP; shuffled minus ESM-2: −0.003093. The random-width control is undecided, not equivalent.
cards.inputs: Frozen ESM-2 with aligned/shuffled ESM-IF1 and random-width controls
cards.estimand: Macro pair AP differences; seed-bootstrap intervals
cards.boundary: Training-seed repeatability is not population confirmation or universal alignment necessity.

cards.title: Same-AA shuffling isolates correspondence damage
cards.answer: ESM-IF1 identity AP 0.027995 becomes 0.011100 under same-AA shuffle; component-weighted paired effect about −0.017151.
cards.inputs: Same-amino-acid permutation retains residue types and feature multiset but breaks correspondence
cards.estimand: Complex-weighted levels versus component/seed-weighted effects; crossed intervals
cards.boundary: Synthetic sensitivity does not establish natural misregistration prevalence. Same-AA shuffling is not correspondence-preserving.

cards.title: Registered holdout: one encoder confirms
cards.answer: ProteinMPNN aligned−shuffled: +0.003594 AP,9/10 favorable, interval above zero. ESM-IF1: +0.002260,6/10, interval includes zero. Both outcomes must remain visible.
cards.inputs: ProteinMPNN and ESM-IF1 correspondence controls
cards.estimand: Per-encoder paired macro AP contrast and registered decision rule
cards.boundary: Disclosed 32-case overlap with a different exposed baseline test. The 185-case sensitivity does not replace the registered outcome; do not pool encoder seed counts.

cards.title: Learned rescue: synthetic gain with clean-input cost
cards.answer: Same-AA rescued−corrupted AP: +0.0157209,95% CI [0.0112560,0.0211527]. Clean inputs incur about −0.001430 component-weighted AP cost.
cards.inputs: Trained residue matcher and fixed downstream models
cards.estimand: Equal-component/equal-paired-seed effect; pointwise crossed seed×component bootstrap
cards.boundary: 1,953 rows are repeated observations of 217 complexes, not 1,953 biological samples. Not OOD, natural-corruption detection or production improvement.

cards.title: Gating reduces clean damage but does not establish safety
cards.answer: All registered synthetic corruptions trigger. Clean damage becomes −0.0004598 AP, crossed CI [−0.0011427,+0.0000198]; no clean-safety guarantee.
cards.cohort: 217 development complexes /68 components; train-only threshold calibration
cards.inputs: Label-free gate; no contact AP used to choose thresholds
cards.estimand: Equal-component/equal-seed contrasts and crossed intervals
cards.boundary: Train-clean trigger≈0.39% becomes 15.67% /17.97% /0.46% on validation. No post-hoc noninferiority margin or deployment guarantee.

cards.title: Cheap selectors also detect synthetic corruption
cards.answer: Moved-fraction and related inexpensive statistics also detect same-AA/global permutations at or near 100%. The synthetic construction moves about 91% of same-AA rows and nearly all globally shuffled rows.
cards.inputs: Label-free heuristic controls
cards.estimand: Detection and clean-trigger rates, not downstream AP
cards.boundary: Counterevidence to a uniquely capable natural-error detector. Preserve the synthetic-line stopping boundary; no repeated threshold tuning on exposed outcomes.

# Cohorts, estimators and comparisons

[Atlas](README.md) · [Audit findings](REVIEW_FINDINGS.md)

# # A sample count is not a dataset identity

| Authority | Role and valid interpretation | Invalid inference |
|---|---|---|
| Development 217 /68 components | Exposed SAbDab2 development; matched grid/arm comparisons | Fresh test; repeated corruption rows as independent samples |
| Registered holdout 217 | Separate registered read, disclosed 32-case overlap with another exposed baseline test | Same cohort as development 217; replacing the answer by 185-case sensitivity |
| Aligned historical test 549 | Checkpoint-specific exposed historical test | Fresh blind or proved sequence-double-cold generalization |
| Old FrameContact cache 455 |272 train /73 validation /110 held out for that checkpoint; provenance correction | A valid headline test score, or proof all 455-case studies are invalid |
| Official 455 in EPIC reconstruction | Distinct authority, historically exposed test | Original submitted OpenDDE checkpoint or pristine benchmark |
| EPIC 321 validation | Carved from official training | An official validation release or demonstrated cluster-disjoint split |
| Newer EPIC 324 validation | Reported cluster-disjoint 324 /82 clusters; evidence pending | Automatic test transfer of task-specific selection |
| AsEP group/ratio | Distinct task axes and test histories; same-split per-complex MCC | Pooled scores compared to macro published tables |
| Newer AsEP 1553 | Reported overlap-stratified frozen-model diagnostic | Strict OOD from one incompletely specified identity threshold |
| Strict dual-axis retrieval | Prospective authority-train protocol; builder AND independent audit required | Results from a canary, or unknown pairings treated as verified negatives |
| AbCite PMC/ViDoRe/VQA/audio-video | Distinct query construction, galleries and answerers | A unified model leaderboard or antibody accuracy |

# # Keep each estimator attached

Macro AP averages per-complex AP. Pooled AP concatenates candidate pairs. Equal-component AP averages within components and then across components. They weight cases differently and can order models differently.

A mean or median of per-seed AP is not AP of averaged ensemble predictions. Compare a new ensemble with an unchanged-model seed ensemble before assigning gains to new components.

Ratio of means and mean of per-seed ratios differ; keep absolute paired differences primary. Resampling seeds, complexes, PDB blocks and components addresses different uncertainties. A crossed seed×component bootstrap is not a PDB-block bootstrap after averaging seeds. Pointwise intervals are not simultaneous family intervals.

AP is not accuracy or P@k: AP 0.024 does not imply 97.6% false predictions in any specified top-k set. Show measured precision/recall at candidate budgets. AP/prevalence ratios are not a matched random-baseline experiment.

A confidence interval crossing zero does not establish equivalence, clean-safety or uselessness. Noninferiority/equivalence requires a justified prespecified margin and corresponding analysis.

A comparison key should include cohort hash, split role, label rule, candidate axes, input access, checkpoint selection, seed rule, aggregation and uncertainty unit. Missing keys allow contextual discussion, not an automatically fair ranked table. Exact sources are bound in the result cards.

# Presentation audit —7 October 2026

[Atlas](README.md) · [All branches](BRANCHES.md)

This is reporting and evidence-location review, not an independent rerun or a declaration that off-Git files do not exist. Historical artifacts remain unchanged; result cards bind sources to commits and hashes.

## 1. Stale completion claims on the landing page

Original main README uses the September 30 operations snapshot: 12/36 PLM tasks, structure RePaRank incomplete. Final receipts record 36/36 with no promotion and centered RePaRank 217/217. Correct the generator, not only its output. Keep scheduler snapshots historical, not falsely live.

## 2. An old branch archive is not the current branch inventory

The preserved archive has 17 snapshots and 747 evidence-path links. This audit has 30 HEADs,103,552 repeated tree entries,4,913 distinct path/blob versions and 4,756 Git blobs. Units and observation dates must remain separate.

## 3. Completed evidence is scattered across side branches

Final rescue, centered RePaRank and structural-PLM evidence is not all stored locally on main. Fixed-commit links resolve this without merging experiment implementations or moving hash-bound files.

## 4. The October 4 manuscript has an evidence-publication gap

Latest main adds reviewer Markdown reporting 75 ablation models,75 improvement models, new OpenDDE, specialist and AsEP experiments. Matching terminal artifacts were not identified in the 30 HEAD trees. The earlier 36-task running ledger and synthetic integration test cannot verify those later results. Mark them report-only, not false or never run.

To close the gap, attach condition/seed/run membership, source/split hashes, selection freezes, terminal receipts, per-seed/per-complex metrics, uncertainty outputs and raw-prediction location/hashes. Existing off-Git artifacts may suffice; this audit does not require rerunning training.

## 5. Counts and analysis authority need reconciliation

The report’s 75 further models are described as rounds of 6 and 12 arms×3 seeds: that accounts for 54, not 75 without extra entries. The earlier frozen plan uses crossed seed×complex uncertainty; the newer report says simultaneous PDB-block bootstrap after seed averaging. Link the actual revised analysis authority and freeze, rather than silently conflating protocols.

## 6. EPIC v2 needs model identity and selection-transfer context

Original submitted checkpoint is not exactly restored. Reconstructed AF3 scores cannot be labelled as the original submission. The contact-selected ensemble fails to beat the unchanged-model ensemble on test, while the paratope-selected ensemble happens to lead all tasks. Separate successful paratope selection, exploratory cross-task observations and seed-ensemble versus component contributions. Check ambiguous as-published labels.

## 7. Identical sample counts cause false comparisons

Development 217 is not holdout 217; historical test 549 is not later development 549. A checkpoint-specific invalid 455 cache does not invalidate official 455 under another authority. Use the cohort guide before creating any ranking.

## 8. AP was incorrectly translated into top-k precision

The decoder README infers 97.6% false top-ranked pairs from AP≈0.024. That is not a valid interpretation of AP. Its decoder-choice-does-not-matter heading also exceeds what one seed establishes. Keep the original file but place this correction at the entry route and report actual P@k/recall metrics.

## 9. Pair structure is not proven partner identification

Exceeding the model’s marginal outer product establishes a within-complex scoring margin. It does not alone show true-antigen identification among alternatives. The full-grid counterevidence and newer near-chance decoy report must be presented alongside it. Head/contact consistency is also not partner specificity.

## 10. Estimator and uncertainty language remains important

The claims ledger correctly distinguishes ratio-of-means and mean-of-ratios near its top, but still says mean of per-seed ratios throughout later. Do not unify these numbers by renaming. Keep component/complex weighting, seed/block uncertainty and pointwise/simultaneous intervals separate. A zero-crossing interval is not equivalence, safety or universal failure.

## 11. Newer prose has scope and coverage inconsistencies

OpenDDE full-completion wording must retain the disclosed long-entity AF3 fallback. AsEP external-diagnostic versus no-external-test wording needs consistent chronology/scope. Reported label matches are 3,047/3,208, or 3,169 at tolerance: do not introduce 3,208/3,208 float 16 without its actual certificate. AUTHOR TO CONFIRM fields remain unresolved.

## 12. Negative results and application boundaries are part of the work

Retain structural-PLM no-promotion, clean-input rescue damage, cheap-gate controls, failed OOD admission, non-replicated MRR anomaly, Hadamard non-win and AbCite LoRA regression. AbCite retrieval is a separate application, not more antibody-prediction evidence. Branch copies are not replications.

## Review depth

All 30 HEAD trees and source-object bytes are mechanically inventoried and hashed. Selected load-bearing readouts and numeric fields are reviewed in detail. Supporting artifacts, code, images and protocols are also catalogued, but not all manually adjudicated. This is not a claim to have read every code line, binary figure, historical commit or off-Git file. Verification records exact checks and exclusions.

# Present every result in three layers

[Atlas](README.md) · [Cohorts](COHORTS.md) · [Findings](REVIEW_FINDINGS.md)

## Layer 1: landing page

Lead with bounded questions and a few protocol-scoped results, not a cross-cohort leaderboard. Final decisions such as 36/36 complete with no promotion are more informative than training counts. Newer manuscript claims need their own labelled evidence-pending section.

## Layer 2: uniform result cards

Each card includes answer, evidence level, cohort, model/input access, seeds, estimator/uncertainty, limitations and exact source links. Put controls and negative endpoints beside gains. Separate interface prediction, correspondence, objectives, external baselines, screening, retrieval, engineering, newer EPIC reports and AbCite.

## Layer 3: branch and source provenance

Thirty branch pages show role, HEAD, ahead/behind and exact differences from original main. The full explorer contains 4,913 path/blob versions with memberships; the evidence-location catalogue includes all files under its documented filter. Do not relocate frozen files for cosmetic tidiness. Preserve the old 17-snapshot archive.

## Plot designs for future evidence-bound figures

| Question | Display | Required guardrail |
|---|---|---|
| Representation/objective effect | Paired-difference intervals around zero | One cohort and declared uncertainty unit; pointwise versus simultaneous separated |
| Structural PLM selection | Every real layer versus its own random-width control | All 10 contrasts, tie-window selection and no-promotion verdict |
| Rescue | Corruption benefit and clean cost in separate panels | Equal-complex levels differ from equal-component deltas; repeated conditions are not samples |
| Contact usefulness | P@10/P@50, recall, precision-recall curves | Matching prediction grid; never derive P@k from AP |
| EPIC v2 | Single model→unchanged ensemble→component ensemble | Frozen per-task selection and failed contact-selection transfer |
| RePaRank | Sequence, uncentered mismatch, corrected-centered | Separate macro/pooled metrics and input-access caveats |
| AbCite | Separate figure/page/VQA/real-media panels | No fixture/held-out/synthetic/official-harness mixing |

These are presentation specifications, not claims that new plots have been computed from off-Git predictions. The current HTML provides source-linked cards and complete searchable tables.

## Adding results

Attach terminal artifacts before upgrading a report-only card. Register numeric JSON selectors and expected values. Keep this dated source snapshot immutable; create a new dated snapshot for newer HEADs. Rebuild/check the atlas and run the historical-preservation verifier. A newer date or stronger prose alone cannot upgrade evidence.
